_comment: Edit this file to change what the booking calendar offers. It is read at
page load, so a change here takes effect on the next refresh — no code.
hours        Open window per weekday, [firstHour, lastHour] on a 24h clock.
Use null for a day you never take.
minNoticeDays How far ahead the first bookable day sits.
maxAheadDays  How far out the calendar will accept a booking.
blackout     Whole days that are closed (holidays, travel, deadlines).
busy         Specific blocks already taken. Google Calendar can fill this
in automatically — see the note at the top of contact.js.
